lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach sabad bin kabahu na chhootas birathaa janam bhaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the True Word of the Shabad, you shall never be released, and your life shall be totally useless. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਠਿਨ ਪੀਰ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan mahi kaam krodh hau mamataa kathin peer at bhaaree ||
lines.translation: Within the body are sexual desire, anger, egotism and attachment. This pain is so great, and so difficult to endure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh raam japahu ras rasanaa in bidh tar too taaree ||2||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Lord's Name, and savor it with your tongue; in this way, you shall cross over to the other side. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹਰੇ ਕਰਨ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਹੋਛੀ ਸਬਦ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahare karan akal bhaee hochhee sabad sahaj nahee boojhiaa ||
lines.translation: Your ears are deaf, and your intellect is worthless, and still, you do not intuitively understand the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath manamukh haariaa bin gur a(n)dh na soojhiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh wastes this priceless human life and loses it. Without the Guru, the blind person cannot see. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahai udaas aas niraasaa sahaj dhiaan bairaagee ||
lines.translation: Whoever remains detached and free of desire in the midst of desire - and whoever, unattached, intuitively meditates on the Celestial Lord

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak guramukh chhootas raam naam liv laagee ||4||2||3||
lines.translation: - prays Nanak, as Gurmukh, he is released. He is lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂੰਡੀ ਚਾਲ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਖਿਸਰੇ ਤੁਚਾ ਦੇਹ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoo(n)dee chaal charan kar khisare tuchaa deh kumalaanee ||
lines.translation: His walk becomes weak and clumsy, his feet and hands shake, and the skin of his body is withered and wrinkled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਧੁੰਧਿ ਕਰਨ ਭਏ ਬਹਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: netree dhu(n)dh karan bhae bahare manamukh naam na jaanee ||1||
lines.translation: His eyes are dim, his ears are deaf, and yet, the self-willed manmukh does not know the Naam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhule kiaa paaiaa jag aai ||
lines.translation: O blind man, what have you obtained by coming into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ridai nahee gur kee sevaa chaale mool gavaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord is not in your heart, and you do not serve the Guru. After wasting your capital, you shall have to depart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਬ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਬ ਫੀਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihavaa ra(n)g nahee har raatee jab bolai tab pheeke ||
lines.translation: Your tongue is not imbued with the Love of the Lord; whatever you say is tasteless and insipid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਨੀਕੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kee ni(n)daa viaapas pasoo bhae kade hohi na neeke ||2||
lines.translation: You indulge in slander of the Saints; becoming a beast, you shall never be noble. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit kaa ras viralee paaiaa satigur mel milaae ||
lines.translation: Only a few obtain the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Amrit, united in Union with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag sabad bhed nahee aaiaa tab lag kaal sa(n)taae ||3||
lines.translation: As long as the mortal does not come to understand the mystery of the Shabad, the Word of God, he shall continue to be tormented by death. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਏਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: an ko dar ghar kabahoo na jaanas eko dar sachiaaraa ||
lines.translation: Whoever finds the door of the One True Lord, does not know any other house or door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||3||4||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; so says poor Nanak. ||4||3||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagalee rain sovat gal phaahee dinas ja(n)jaal gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He spends the entire night in sleep; the noose is tied around his neck. His day is wasted in worldly entanglements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal ghaRee nahee prabh jaaniaa jin ihu jagat upaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: He does not know God, who created this world, for a moment, for even an instant. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re kiu chhootas dukh bhaaree ||
lines.translation: O mortal, how will you escape this terrible disaster?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa le aavas kiaa le jaavas raam japahu gunakaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: What did you bring with you, and what will you take away? Meditate on the Lord, the Most Worthy and Generous Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਂਧਉ ਕਵਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: oo(n)dhau kaval manamukh mat hochhee man a(n)dhai sir dha(n)dhaa ||
lines.translation: The heart-lotus of the self-willed manmukh is upside-down; his intellect is shallow; his mind is blind, and his head is entangled in worldly affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗਲਿ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal sadaa sir terai bin naavai gal pha(n)dhaa ||2||
lines.translation: Death and re-birth constantly hang over your head; without the Name, your neck shall be caught in the noose. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਗਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੁਨਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dagaree chaal netr phun a(n)dhule sabad surat nahee bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Your steps are unsteady, and your eyes are blind; you are not aware of the Word of the Shabad, O Sibling of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧੁਲਉ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saasatr bed trai gun hai maaiaa a(n)dhulau dha(n)dh kamaaee ||3||
lines.translation: The Shaastras and the Vedas keep the mortal bound to the three modes of Maya, and so he performs his deeds blindly. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਇਓ ਮੂਲੁ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khoio mool laabh kah paavas duramat giaan vihoone ||
lines.translation: He loses his capital - how can he earn any profit? The evil-minded person has no spiritual wisdom at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabad beechaar raam ras chaakhiaa naanak saach pateene ||4||4||5||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; O Nanak, his faith is confirmed in the Truth. ||4||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g rahai din raatee raam rasan ra(n)g raataa ||
lines.translation: He remains with the Guru, day and night, and his tongue savors the savory taste of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avar na jaanas sabad pachhaanas a(n)tar jaan pachhaataa ||1||
lines.translation: He does not know any other; he realizes the Word of the Shabad. He knows and realizes the Lord deep within his own being. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jan aisaa mai man bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Such a humble person is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap maar apara(n)par raataa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He conquers his self-conceit, and is imbued with the Infinite Lord. He serves the Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar purakh nira(n)jan aad purakh aadeso ||
lines.translation: Deep within my being, and outside as well, is the Immaculate Lord God. I bow humbly before that Primal Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa sach veso ||2||
lines.translation: Deep within each and every heart, and amidst all, the Embodiment of Truth is permeating and pervading. ||2||
